background: Bruce H. Jolley is a Big Horn County commissioner. The official commissioners page lists him as a member. He won the November 2024 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he was not on the 2026 county-office ballot because two years remained on his term, and that commissioner-elect Jared Boardman said he looked forward to working with Laird and sitting commissioner Jolley.
